sentences.text: Amanulla Laskar vs The State Of West Bengal & Ors on 4
December, 2024

Author: Tirthankar Ghosh
Bench: Tirthankar Ghosh
04.12.2024 W.P.A. 24178 of 2024
 Item No.26
 Ct. No.35
 dc.
 Amanulla Laskar
 versus
 The State of West Bengal & Ors.
 Mr. Jagannath Ganguly,
 Mr. Tanmay Manna ...
For the Petitioner.
Mr. Suman Ghosh,
Mr. Siddhartha Ghosh ...
For the State.
State has submitted a report enclosing the  statement of the present petitioner viz. Amanulla  Laskar.
Let the same be kept with the record.
A  copy of the report be handed over to the learned  advocate appearing for the petitioner.
The said report reflects that the petitioner  and his wife are staying together.

In spite of the  same, they are fighting in court under Sections  498A/34 of the Indian Penal Code as also a  counter-case initiated at the behest of the mother of  the petitioner under Sections  341/342/323/325/379/506/34 of the Indian  Penal Code.

The petitioner has approached this Court for Amanulla Laskar vs The State Of West Bengal & Ors on 4 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/83665684/
1  recovery of certain testimonials and deed which are  still lying in the custody of the private respondents.

entities.text: Amanulla Laskar vs The State Of West Bengal & Ors on 4 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The private respondents include the wife of the petitioner and her relations.
Search was conducted by the police authorities.
Nothing could be recovered.
Prima facie it seems that the petitioner and his wife are in a relationship, as such the police authorities are unable to use the excesses under law.

Under the aforesaid circumstances, if the wife of the petitioner aids the police authorities in recovery of the testimonials and the deed, the police authorities would take appropriate steps in accordance with law.
In view of the report which has been submitted and the steps taken by the police authorities, further pendency of the writ petition is unwarranted.
Accordingly, the writ petition being WPA 24178 of 2024 is disposed of.
There shall be no order as to costs.
All concerned parties shall act on the server copy of this order duly downloaded from the official website of this Court.
Urgent photostat certified copy of this order, if applied for, be supplied to the parties upon compliance with all requisite formalities.

(Tirthankar Ghosh, J.)
